title: The Error Your Checksum Can't See
summary: Corrupt a message four different ways and watch a checksum and a CRC of the same width disagree about whether anything happened.

sources.title: Peterson and Brown, Cyclic Codes for Error Detection (Proc. IRE, 1961)
Koopman and Chakravarty, CRC Polynomial Selection for Embedded Networks (DSN, 2004)
